title: Find Median from Data Stream
description: Design a data structure that supports adding integers from a stream and returning the median of all elements added so far.

reference.use_case: Reporting the running median of a stream of measurements, such as median response time or median order value, as new data points arrive.
system_examples: Application performance monitoring — live p50 latency on dashboards
Signal processing — median filters that remove spikes from noisy sensor readings
Finance — rolling median prices that are robust to outliers
reference.explanation: Keep the lower half in a max-heap and the upper half in a min-heap, balanced in size, for O(log n) inserts and O(1) median reads. At very large scale systems switch to approximate quantile sketches (t-digest, Datadog's DDSketch), but the two-heap design is the exact baseline.
